module: "Pathnodes" (waypoints) subtool of the Crawl editor. The module returns a class constructor C. It edits the nodes of a path (path.pathnodes, path.segments): mouse selection, manual creation (Shift+click), moving/rotating the normal/scaling the radius with the axis gizmo, and custom fields. It draws the nodes, the segments linking the sorted nodes and a selection text. All modifications go through editor.history (undo/redo).
notes: In selectPathnode, setSelectedPathnodeIndex and selectedPathnode, "index" is the node id (key of path.pathnodes.objects), not its position in the sorted list.
Shift held: manual node creation mode (default radius 5.0, linked by a segment to the last sorted node if one exists).
The gizmo scale only changes the node's radius (negative value brought back to 0).
The gizmo is only used if crawlEditor.allowGizmo() returns a true value.
A status text is drawn on screen at (10, 10, 0): "Selected Pathnode: <name> <id>" or "No pathnode selected".

C.desc: Tool instance. Fields: crawlEditor (parent editor), path (edited path), index (id of the selected node, -1 by default), mouseInfo (last mouse info), fields (ImGui buffers of the custom fields).

init.desc: Constructor: stores the parent Crawl editor and initializes selection, fields and drag data.

setPath.desc: Sets the path whose nodes are being edited.

selectPathnode.desc: Selects the node with the given id: updates the drawing mode (highlight/normal) of the nodes, places the gizmo on it and clears the custom fields. Does nothing if id is nil.

updateTransform.desc: Places the gizmo on the node position (oriented according to its normal in local alignment). No effect if the gizmo is not allowed.

beginDrag.desc: Start of gizmo manipulation: stores the serialized state, rotation and radius of the node.

dragging.desc: During manipulation: translation (gizmo position), rotation (new normal, if the node has one) or scale (radius).

endDragging.desc: End of manipulation: records the "Manipulated Pathnode via Gizmo" action in the history with the old and new state.

selectedPathnode.desc: Returns the selected node, or nil if there is none or if it is marked missing.

handleMouseDown.desc: Click: selects the hovered node, or deselects if the gizmo is not clicked.

createManualPathnode.desc: Displays "Add manual Pathnode (Click to place)" at the targeted point; on click, creates (undoable) a node at the raycast point, radius 5.0, name "Pathnode", and a segment from the last sorted node.

mouseOverPathnodes.desc: Looks for the node closest to the camera whose distance to the mouse ray is ≤ 1.0 m.

drawPathnodeSelectionIndicators.desc: Draws all nodes (highlight, normal or faded mode depending on the selection and the "Edit Pathnodes" edit mode), the segments and the status text.

drawPathnodeSegments.desc: Draws a prism between each pair of consecutive sorted nodes with the label "Segment from-to"; more opaque in "Edit Pathnodes" mode.

draw.desc: Called every frame: stores mouseInfo and, if the gizmo is allowed, updates the gizmo and processes input.

input.desc: Processes input: indicators, manual creation with Shift, hover and selection on click. Does nothing if mouseInfo.valid is false.

drawPathnodeList.desc: Draws the trail's node list with the "Add Pathnode" button (creates a node at the camera position, radius 5.0).

drawPathnodeDetail.desc: Draws the detail panel of a node (name, position, radius, normal, custom fields...) with undo history.

getSelectedPathnodeIndex.desc: Returns the id of the selected node.

setSelectedPathnodeIndex.desc: Sets the selected id without updating the gizmo or the drawing (unlike selectPathnode).

drawCustomFields.desc: Draws the custom fields editor of a node (names/types/values tables; string type edited via a 4096-character field). Creates the tables if absent.
